title: polish
category: sub-skill of concept-art · surgical edits (rounds 2-3 max)
short_summary: runs surgical nano banana 2 image-to-image edits on failing 2k plates in rounds 2 and 3 only while freezing passing slots at round 1.
when_to_use: use at stage 4 of jason-design-agent when eval flags localized defects and rounds used is under 3.
summary: Executes research-enriched, surgical Nano Banana 2 refinement passes in Rounds 2 and 3 on 2K concept plates that fail eval or return weak design. Whenever a slot comes back with bad or uninspired design, runs a targeted micro-research pass (2-3 fresh competitor or inner-design examples for that exact pattern) and feeds richer textural, designer, and frontend-developer steering into the prompt while enforcing the hard 3-round Nano Banana ceiling. Use when eval flags design, hierarchy, palette, framing, or canon.md defects and rounds used is less than 3. Don't use for initial 12-slot generation (use image-gen) or when a slot has already reached 3 rounds.
